messages:
Maya PM: Quick sync — we need a one-pager + benchmark narrative for Healthcare (HIPAA) hybrid/private deployments. Target: field enablement + webinar tie-in. Goal: ship by next Tue. Link: https://tiny.redwood/brief-template
Dan (Marketing): On it. I'll draft messaging that leads with SLA & data isolation. Need any compliance quotes?
Olivia (ML Research): I'll pull perf numbers from last private-run and write a 2-paragraph benchmark blurb. Can include p95/p99 and cost delta vs hosted.
Lee (AE): Please emphasize 'enterprise routing'—we need a clear CTA: demo requests from healthcare -> Enterprise AE queue. Also add 'HIPAA compliance + KMS + audit logs' bullet.
jr_sales_ops: Routing detail: can we set up inbound tag rule? Proposed: tag=healthcare OR keyword=[HIPAA, PHI] -> enterprise-sales@team (cc: field)
Sarah (Design): I'll do a single-sheet hero + 3 callouts: SLA, Network isolation, Key mgmt. Need final copy by Friday to hit design review.
Dan (Marketing): Proposed assets: 1) one-pager PDF, 2) benchmark mini-appendix, 3) 90-sec launch post for LinkedIn, 4) webinar (30m product + 15m compliance panel). Thoughts?
Maya PM: Love it. Webinar: product demo + a compliance lawyer from partner org. Promo cadence: announce post day 0, webinar day +7, field follow-up w/ one-pager + benchmark PDF.
Olivia (ML Research): Quick perf notes: private-dedicated (A100x8, pinned model) median gen latency 42ms @512 tokens, p95 85ms. Shared-hosted median 60ms, p95 120ms. Cost per 1k tokens ~0.9x vs hosted when using batching+cache. I'll attach CSV to draft doc.
Dan (Marketing): I'll write the copy and a short email template for inbound. Draft by EOD Thu.
Maya PM: Routing: @inbound-bot can you create rule for healthcare leads? Conditions: contains(HIPAA|PHI|healthcare) OR form field:industry == Healthcare -> route Enterprise AE queue + tag 'healthcare'
inbound-bot: Rule created: id=hc-route-2026, condition=contains(HIPAA,PHI,healthcare), action=route->enterprise-sales, notify=jr_sales_ops
Lee (AE): Great. For field enablement, include 3 quick objection responses: infra cost, latency, auditability.
Dan (Marketing): I'll bake those into the one-pager FAQs and into the webinar slide deck. :tada:
Maya PM: Perfect. Final deliverables list in doc: one-pager PDF, benchmark appendix (CSV+bullets), LinkedIn post copy, email template, webinar landing page. Owning: Dan (copy), Sarah (design), Olivia (benchmarks), Lee (sales review).
